title: Memilih pasar dan cara masuk untuk Perusahaan Simulasi A
notice: Semua perusahaan, pasar, skor, angka, batas keputusan, dan persetujuan dalam kasus ini adalah simulasi orisinal; bukan data McKinsey atau perusahaan nyata.
model_basis: Pre-tax nominal incremental project cash flows versus do nothing; no financing cashflows; t0 followed by five equal annual periods; no terminal business value. Working capital is recovered at t5. Timing/ramp is already reflected in annual contributions.
score_basis: Synthetic ordinal scores 1-5; higher is better. Weighted scores are prioritization inputs, not market statistics or proof of economic value.

decision.ask: Authorize partner entry up to IDR 1.5 billion initial funding, conditional on a signed contract and confirmation of the modeled contribution economics.
release_conditions: CFO validates contribution assumptions and downside case
Launch plan remains within six months
decision.fallback: Do nothing if conditions fail; do not silently substitute an excluded mode.
